title: Naming the Whole --- Family, Nickname, Relative, Partner, Baby
label: ch:familia-y-pareja
canDo: I can name a family, a partner, a relative and a baby in Spanish, and I can say what somebody is called by nickname as well as by name and surname.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C309-bebe: gather the whole household into one word, add the third kind of name, and close on the youngest person in the room.
